prompts.name: flex
prompts.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Reference image is the exact existing game character, not a pose guide. Make a production sprite sheet of THIS SAME Ignacio Mustacho: brown-skinned slender adult, huge black moustache, full straight black fringe with swept-up side hair wings, large expressive eyes, green jersey with ivory 00 and ivory piping, green shorts, ivory sneakers. Match face, body proportions, outfit, detailed sculpted illustration and lighting precisely. Genuine transparent background, no ground, no shadow, no text, no ball, no hoop, no extra objects. EXACTLY 12 full-body sequential animation frames in THREE columns and FOUR rows, chronological row-major order. Equal cell dimensions, same camera and scale, constant foot baseline, generous transparent margins so no two figures or their raised hands touch neighboring cells. Each frame is a distinct smoothly drawn in-between, no motion trails, no ghost limbs. All movement stays inside each cell. Frames 1 and 12 use same relaxed upright ready pose with feet shoulder-width apart. Celebration of reaching 10: a playful RIGHT BICEPS FLEX. 1 ready, 2 right elbow starts bending, 3 forearm rises, 4 fist near shoulder, 5 elbow rotates outward, 6 full biceps flex with left hand on hip, 7 proud raised eyebrow and smile holding flex, 8 tiny wrist flourish, 9 begin lowering, 10 elbow relaxes, 11 near ready, 12 ready. Warm self-confident champion, gentle humor, no aggression.
